body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. READ-ONLY REVIEW of D1 041872e — ACCEPT.

Exact SHA 041872e596dc323659f5b7281c8374f2470dc12a. Stack of six commits, all this slice; first parent is b1f5153. Main has since moved to 0c5a1a4 (D2). No source-path overlap with D2 (I diffed). Chief can merge the trees. I did not run the gate.

WHAT IS CLOSED, both types:
  - `final class … private`, not a case class. No `copy`, no `fromProduct`.
  - Construction path is `of`. `replace` rebuilds through `of` (re-validates).
  - Probes live outside the defining packages (`embedprobe`, `acquireprobe`).
  - Same-shape positive controls: `InstructionDigest.fromProduct` (embed) and `PromptPackageRef.fromProduct` (acquire). Not tuples.
  - Runtime refusals are in the probe: `of(..., window=0)` is Left; blank-name manifest is Invalid.

Forge-first is in the history (9b291ac minted window=0 via fromProduct) and then closed. That is the sweep shape.

NARROWS, not blocks:
  - Posted gate is acquire JVM/JS/Native 76 and embed-core JVM/JS 142, compileAll, then format on acquireJVM+embedCoreJVM. I did not see embed-core Native or scalafmtCheckAll. Chief's merged-tree run covers that.
  - `validated`/`validate` still return the same type. Correct now: constructor is private.

I hold nothing.
